# API Contract — The Champions Club (v1)

> **The single agreement between frontend and backend.** If an endpoint, field or error is not here, it does not exist. To change anything: edit `tools/api/endpoints.mjs`, run `npm run docs:build`, commit every regenerated file in the SAME pull request, and get the owner of the module (see ownership below) plus one other developer to approve.
>
> Machine-readable twin: [openapi.yaml](openapi.yaml) · Request/query TypeScript types: [requests.generated.ts](../../shared/types/requests.generated.ts) · Response types: [rows.ts](../../shared/types/rows.ts), [api.ts](../../shared/types/api.ts) · Errors: [ERROR_CODES.md](../contracts/ERROR_CODES.md) · Permissions: [PERMISSIONS_MATRIX.md](../security/PERMISSIONS_MATRIX.md)

## 1. Global conventions

| Topic | Rule |
|---|---|
| **Base URL** | `{API_BASE_URL}/api/v1` — e.g. `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`. Every path below is relative to it. |
| **Versioning** | Version is in the URL (`/api/v1`). Within v1 only **additive, backward-compatible** changes are allowed (new optional field, new endpoint, new enum value announced to the team). Anything breaking (rename, remove, type change, new required field) requires `/api/v2` — see [ADR-012](../decisions/ADR-012-api-versioning.md). |
| **Content type** | Requests and responses are `application/json; charset=utf-8` (except `GET /reports/export` = CSV). |
| **Authentication** | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` obtained from `/auth/login` or `/auth/signup`. Endpoints marked **PUBLIC** need no token. Token lifetime 8 h; expired/invalid => `401 AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED`. |
| **Authorisation** | Role list per endpoint. `(own only)` = the caller may only touch records that belong to them (member → their `member_id`; business client → their `business_client_id`; staff → their `staff` row). Violations: `403 FORBIDDEN` (or `404` when revealing existence would leak data). |
| **Success envelope** | `{ "success": true, "data": <payload>, "message"?: string, "meta"?: PageMeta }` |
| **Error envelope** | `{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "<ERROR_CODE>", "message": string, "details"?: object } }` — `code` is always one of [ERROR_CODES.md](../contracts/ERROR_CODES.md). HTTP status is fixed per code. `VALIDATION_ERROR.details.fields` = `{ "<field>": "<message>" }`. |
| **Pagination** | List endpoints marked `Page<T>` accept `?page=1&page_size=20` (default 20, max 100) and return `meta: { page, page_size, total, total_pages }`. Other arrays are unpaginated and bounded. |
| **Sorting** | Fixed per endpoint (documented in the rules). No client-controlled sort in v1. |
| **JSON naming** | `snake_case` for every key, identical to DB column names. No camelCase anywhere. |
| **IDs** | UUID v4 strings. Human-readable numbers (`member_code`, `booking_number`, `order_number`, `payment_number`, `invoice_number`) are display fields only — never used as foreign keys. |
| **Timestamps** | UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds and `Z`: `2026-10-03T12:30:00.000Z`. UI converts to IST (`Asia/Kolkata`) for display. |
| **Dates / times** | Business dates are IST calendar dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; times of day are `HH:mm:ss`. Court `start_at` values must fall on :00 or :30. |
| **Money** | Strings with exactly 2 decimals in INR: `"1250.00"`. Never JSON numbers. All arithmetic via `shared/lib/money.ts`. |
| **Null vs absent** | Responses always include every documented key (`null` when empty), except fields marked optional (`?`) in the TypeScript view types. Requests: omit optional fields; sending `null` clears nullable fields on PATCH. |
| **PATCH semantics** | Partial update: only keys present are changed. Unknown keys => `VALIDATION_ERROR`. |
| **Idempotency** | Payments and order creation accept an optional header `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>`; a repeated key returns the original response (SHOULD, not required for the MVP). |
| **Status codes** | 200 OK · 201 Created (POST that creates) · 400 VALIDATION_ERROR · 401 · 402 PAYMENT_FAILED · 403 · 404 · 409 conflict/state · 422 business-rule violation · 500. |
| **Rate limits** | Public write endpoints (`POST /enquiries`, `/auth/signup`, `/auth/login`) SHOULD be rate-limited (e.g. 10/min/IP). |

### Standard objects

```ts
interface PageMeta { page: number; page_size: number; total: number; total_pages: number }
```

## 4. Endpoints

---

### Module: Authentication

*Owner: Dev 1 (Platform, Identity & Public Experience)*

<a id="authsignup"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/auth/signup` — auth.signup

Visitor joins as a member: account + the chosen membership, paid online, in one step; the member is logged in.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None (PUBLIC) |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: AuthSession` |
| **Requirements** | FR-AUTH-001, FR-MEM-012 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-SEC-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `users`, `members`, `memberships`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `AuthSignupRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | string | **yes** | 2-120 chars |
| `email` | email | **yes** | unique (case-insensitive) |
| `phone` | phone | **yes** |  |
| `password` | string | **yes** | min 8 chars, >=1 letter and >=1 digit |
| `date_of_birth` | date | no | must be in the past; REQUIRED for a JUNIOR plan |
| `address` | text | no |  |
| `membership_plan_id` | uuid | no | the plan to buy now (paid ONLINE through the mock gateway). Omit to join without a plan. |

**Rules / behaviour:** Creates `users` (role MEMBER) + `members` (+ `memberships` + `payments` when a plan is given) in ONE transaction: if the payment fails nothing is created. The password is stored only as a bcrypt hash.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `EMAIL_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this email already exists. |
| `APPLICATION_PENDING` | 409 | A job application for this email is already waiting for the owner. Log in to see its status. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership plan not found. |
| `JUNIOR_AGE_INVALID` | 422 | Junior plan requires the member to be under 18. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
POST /api/v1/auth/signup
```

<a id="authlogin"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/auth/login` — auth.login

Authenticate and receive a JWT plus the role-based landing route, or the EMPLOYEE_APPLICATION_PENDING state.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None (PUBLIC) |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: AuthSession` |
| **Requirements** | FR-AUTH-002, FR-AUTH-003, FR-AUTH-008 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-SEC-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `users`, `employee_applications` |

**Request body** — type `AuthLoginRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | email | **yes** |  |
| `password` | string | **yes** |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** `redirect_to` = ROLE_HOME_ROUTE[user.role]. Active users are checked first. If there is no such user but a PENDING job application for the email whose bcrypt hash matches, the answer is `{state: EMPLOYEE_APPLICATION_PENDING, redirect_to: /employee-application-pending}`: NO token, NO role. Never reveal whether the email exists (always AUTH_INVALID).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | Invalid email or password. |
| `ACCOUNT_DISABLED` | 403 | This account has been deactivated. |

**Example — Member logs in**

```http
POST /api/v1/auth/login
```

```json
{
  "email": "aarav.kapoor@example.com",
  "password": "Password@123"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs…",
    "expires_at": "2026-10-03T19:45:00.000Z",
    "user": {
      "id": "01000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007",
      "email": "aarav.kapoor@example.com",
      "role": "MEMBER",
      "full_name": "Aarav Kapoor",
      "phone": "+919811100001",
      "is_active": true,
      "must_change_password": false,
      "created_at": "…",
      "updated_at": "…"
    },
    "redirect_to": "/member",
    "member": {
      "id": "02000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      "member_code": "CCM-00001",
      "full_name": "Aarav Kapoor",
      "active_membership": {
        "membership_type": "GOLD",
        "plan_name": "Gold Membership",
        "status": "ACTIVE",
        "end_date": "2027-03-16",
        "days_remaining": 164
      },
      "…": "…"
    },
    "staff": null,
    "business_client": null
  }
}
```


```json

}
```

```json
    "message": "Invalid email or password."
```
```json
  }
}
```

<a id="memberscreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/members` — members.create

Register a new member at the front desk (optionally buying a plan immediately).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: MemberDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-MEM-001, FR-MEM-012 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-MEM-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SEC-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `users`, `members`, `memberships`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `MembersCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | string | **yes** |  |
| `email` | email | **yes** |  |
| `phone` | phone | **yes** |  |
| `date_of_birth` | date | no | REQUIRED when membership_plan_id is a JUNIOR plan |
| `address` | text | no |  |
| `emergency_contact_name` | string | no |  |
| `emergency_contact_phone` | phone | no |  |
| `initial_password` | string | no | if omitted the server generates one; account gets must_change_password = true |
| `membership_plan_id` | uuid | no | buy this plan now |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | no | REQUIRED when membership_plan_id is given |

**Rules / behaviour:** One transaction: users + members (+ memberships + payments when a plan is bought).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `EMAIL_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this email already exists. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership plan not found. |
| `JUNIOR_AGE_INVALID` | 422 | Junior plan requires the member to be under 18. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

<a id="membershipspurchase"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/memberships` — memberships.purchase

Buy or renew a membership. Records the payment.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER (own only), FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: MembershipPurchaseResult` |
| **Requirements** | FR-MEM-007, FR-MEM-012, FR-FIN-001 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-MEM-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-06](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-11](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `memberships`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `MembershipsPurchaseRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `member_id` | uuid | no | Staff only; MEMBER callers: implied = self |
| `membership_plan_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | **yes** | MEMBER callers must use ONLINE |
| `gateway_reference` | string | no |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** No current term: new membership starting today (derived status ACTIVE). Current term ends within `membership_expiry_warning_days`: new term starts the day after the current end_date (derived status UPCOMING until then). Otherwise MEMBERSHIP_ALREADY_ACTIVE (the DB rejects overlapping live terms: memberships_no_overlap). end_date = start_date + duration_months - 1 day. A membership is only member + plan + start/end date + price_paid: its status is derived from the dates (view membership_terms), never stored.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership plan not found. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_ALREADY_ACTIVE` | 409 | Member already has an active membership. |
| `JUNIOR_AGE_INVALID` | 422 | Junior plan requires the member to be under 18. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |


<a id="membershipschangePlan"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/memberships/:id/change-plan` — memberships.changePlan

Upgrade / downgrade: closes the current term and starts a new one on the new plan.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: MembershipPurchaseResult` |
| **Requirements** | FR-MEM-008, FR-MEM-012, FR-FIN-001 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-MEM-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `memberships`, `payments` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Request body** — type `MembershipsChangePlanRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `new_membership_plan_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | **yes** |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** Only an ACTIVE term can be changed (an EXPIRED one => MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED: buy a new membership instead). Old row: end_date = yesterday (it simply ends; its derived status becomes EXPIRED). New row: start_date = today (derived status ACTIVE), full new-plan price charged (no pro-rata; see ASSUMPTIONS A-07). Future bookings keep their already-snapshotted price.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership not found. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership plan not found. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRED` | 403 | Membership has expired; member rates do not apply. |
| `JUNIOR_AGE_INVALID` | 422 | Junior plan requires the member to be under 18. |
| `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | 409 | This status change is not allowed. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

<a id="courtsavailability"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/courts/availability` — courts.availability

Slot grid per court for one day: a slot every 30 min, each a 1-hour session.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None (PUBLIC) |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: CourtAvailability[]` |
| **Requirements** | FR-COURT-002, FR-COURT-003, FR-PUB-003 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-COURT-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `courts`, `court_bookings` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | **yes** | today .. today+60d (IST) |
| `sport_type` | enum SPORT_TYPE | no |  |
| `court_id` | uuid | no |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** Slots: first start = club_open_time, last start = club_close_time - 1h, step 30 min. Status PAST for starts before now. `booking_id` only for FRONT_DESK/OWNER_ADMIN; never expose who booked.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `COURT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Court not found. |

<a id="courtsblock"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/courts/:id/blocks` — courts.block

Block a court for maintenance (creates 1-hour MAINTENANCE bookings covering the range).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: BookingDetail[]` |
| **Requirements** | FR-COURT-013 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-COURT-10](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `court_bookings` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Request body** — type `CourtsBlockRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start_at` | datetime | **yes** | on a 30-min boundary |
| `end_at` | datetime | **yes** | multiple of 1h after start_at |

**Rules / behaviour:** Fails with BOOKING_CONFLICT (and creates nothing) if any hour overlaps a booking that stands.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `COURT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Court not found. |
| `BOOKING_CONFLICT` | 409 | This court is already booked for that time. |
| `INVALID_SLOT` | 422 | Start time must be on a 30-minute boundary, in the future, within opening hours. |

<a id="bookingsprice"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/bookings/price` — bookings.price

Price preview before confirming (applies the member plan discount and shows plays used today).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER, FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: PriceBreakdown` |
| **Requirements** | FR-COURT-012, FR-COURT-007 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-COURT-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `courts`, `memberships`, `membership_plans` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `court_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `start_at` | datetime | **yes** |  |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | staff only; omit for walk-in pricing |

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `COURT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Court not found. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |
| `INVALID_SLOT` | 422 | Start time must be on a 30-minute boundary, in the future, within opening hours. |

<a id="bookingscreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/bookings` — bookings.create

Book a court (member self-service, or staff for a member / walk-in / phone caller).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER, FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: BookingDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-COURT-004, FR-COURT-005, FR-COURT-006, FR-COURT-007, FR-COURT-008, FR-COURT-009, FR-COURT-003 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-COURT-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-06](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-MEM-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `court_bookings`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `BookingsCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `court_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `start_at` | datetime | **yes** | on a :00/:30 boundary, in the future, session must end by club_close_time |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | Staff only: book/order on behalf of this member. MEMBER callers: omit (implied = self). |
| `guest_name` | string | no | Walk-in name. Staff only. Required when no member_id. |
| `guest_phone` | string | no | Walk-in phone (E.164 or 10-digit). Staff only. |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | no | omit = pay later at the desk (payment_status PENDING). MEMBER callers pay ONLINE or later at desk. |

**Rules / behaviour:** Transaction: lock member (advisory) -> check plays-per-day (REGULAR bookings that stand, IST day, max = plan.max_plays_per_day, default 2) -> compute price -> INSERT (DB exclusion constraint `court_bookings_no_overlap` is the final arbiter; map SQLSTATE 23P01 to BOOKING_CONFLICT) -> optional payment. list_price and discount_amount are stored (snapshot); the amount due and payment_status are derived (view court_booking_totals). Expired/no membership => walk-in price. Free (amount due 0) => payment_status NOT_REQUIRED.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `COURT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Court not found. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |
| `INVALID_SLOT` | 422 | Start time must be on a 30-minute boundary, in the future, within opening hours. |
| `COURT_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | Court is closed, inactive, blocked, or outside opening hours. |
| `BOOKING_CONFLICT` | 409 | This court is already booked for that time. |
| `DAILY_BOOKING_LIMIT` | 409 | Member has reached the maximum plays allowed per day. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

**Example — Gold member books for free**

```http
POST /api/v1/bookings
```

```json

  "court_id": "08000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "start_at": "2026-10-10T13:30:00.000Z"
}
```


<a id="bookingstrial"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/bookings/trial` — bookings.trial

A visitor asks for a free trial hour from the public website. Nothing is booked yet: the request waits for the owner (see enquiries.approveTrial).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None (PUBLIC) |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: EnquiryView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-PUB-006, FR-COURT-004 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `enquiries` |

**Request body** — type `BookingsTrialRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **yes** |  |
| `phone` | string | **yes** | exactly 10 digits |
| `email` | email | no |  |
| `sport_type` | enum SPORT_TYPE | **yes** |  |
| `start_at` | datetime | **yes** | on a :00/:30 boundary, in the future, inside opening hours |

**Rules / behaviour:** Transaction: lock the phone number (advisory) -> at most one open trial per phone, i.e. no waiting TRIAL request and no upcoming TRIAL booking (TRIAL_ALREADY_BOOKED) -> require that some active court of the sport is free in the slot, else BOOKING_CONFLICT -> INSERT an enquiry of type TRIAL (sport_type, preferred_start_at, handled_at NULL). The slot is NOT held until the owner approves.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `INVALID_SLOT` | 422 | Start time must be on a 30-minute boundary, in the future, within opening hours. |
| `COURT_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | Court is closed, inactive, blocked, or outside opening hours. |
| `BOOKING_CONFLICT` | 409 | This court is already booked for that time. |
| `TRIAL_ALREADY_BOOKED` | 409 | This phone number already has an upcoming trial booked. |

```http
POST /api/v1/bookings/trial
```

```json
  "phone": "+919811100001",
  "sport_type": "TENNIS",
  "start_at": "2026-10-10T12:30:00.000Z"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "07000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "enquiry_type": "GENERAL",
    "name": "Anita Deshmukh",
    "email": "anita.d@example.com",
    "phone": "+919900100001",
    "message": "What are your timings and do you offer coaching for beginners?",
    "membership_plan_id": null,
    "sport_type": null,

}
```

<a id="bookingscancel"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/bookings/:id/cancel` — bookings.cancel

Cancel a booking before it starts; frees the slot and refunds per policy.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER (own only), FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: BookingCancelResult` |
| **Requirements** | FR-COURT-010 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-COURT-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-COURT-09](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `court_bookings`, `payments` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Request body** — type `BookingsCancelRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refund` | bool | no | staff only: override policy (default: refund if start_at - now >= cancellation_cutoff_hours) |

**Rules / behaviour:** Only a booking that stands and starts in the future. Sets cancelled_at (derived status CANCELLED). Member callers: own bookings only, and policy decides the refund. A refund is recorded on the payment (refunded_amount, refunded_at); the booking then reports payment_status REFUNDED.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `BOOKING_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Booking not found. |
| `BOOKING_NOT_CANCELLABLE` | 409 | This booking can no longer be cancelled. |
| `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | 409 | This status change is not allowed. |

<a id="shoporderCreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/shop/orders` — shop.orderCreate

Place a shop order: member online order (pickup/delivery) or staff counter sale.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER, FRONT_DESK, STORE_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: ShopOrderDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-SHOP-003, FR-SHOP-004, FR-SHOP-005, FR-SHOP-006, FR-SHOP-007, FR-SHOP-008, FR-INV-001, FR-FIN-001 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-SHOP-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SHOP-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SHOP-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SHOP-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SHOP-06](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-11](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `shop_orders`, `shop_order_items`, `products`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `ShopOrderCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | object[] | **yes** | 1-50 lines; duplicate products are merged |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `product_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `quantity` | int | **yes** | 1-99 |
| `fulfillment` | enum ORDER_FULFILLMENT | **yes** | MEMBER: PICKUP\|DELIVERY. Staff: IN_STORE |
| `delivery_address` | text | no | required when fulfillment = DELIVERY |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | Staff only: book/order on behalf of this member. MEMBER callers: omit (implied = self). |
| `guest_name` | string | no | Walk-in name. Staff only. Required when no member_id. |
| `guest_phone` | string | no | Walk-in phone (E.164 or 10-digit). Staff only. |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | no | MEMBER: ONLINE. Staff counter sale: CASH\|CARD\|UPI (required for IN_STORE) |

**Rules / behaviour:** IN_STORE = a counter sale made by staff; PICKUP / DELIVERY = placed online by a member (no separate channel column: it follows from fulfillment). One transaction: `UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - :q WHERE id = :id AND stock_quantity >= :q` per line (0 rows => OUT_OF_STOCK, rollback) + snapshot unit_price + discount_amount = subtotal x shop_discount_percent + delivery_fee (unless free_delivery_above) + payment. Totals and payment_status are derived (view shop_order_totals). IN_STORE orders are created COMPLETED; online orders start PLACED.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Product not found. |
| `OUT_OF_STOCK` | 409 | Insufficient stock for one or more items. |
| `DELIVERY_ADDRESS_REQUIRED` | 422 | Delivery address is required for delivery orders. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

**Example — Member orders shoes for pickup (Silver: 10% off)**

```http
POST /api/v1/shop/orders
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "product_id": "0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010",
      "quantity": 1
    }
  ],
  "fulfillment": "PICKUP",
  "payment_method": "ONLINE"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "order_number": "SO-000011",
    "fulfillment": "PICKUP",
    "status": "PLACED",
    "subtotal": "9495.00",
    "discount_amount": "949.50",
    "delivery_fee": "0.00",
    "total_amount": "8545.50",
    "amount_paid": "8545.50",
    "payment_status": "PAID",
    "items": [
      {
        "product_name": "Nike Court Air Zoom Vapor Shoes",
        "unit_price": "9495.00",
        "quantity": 1
      }
    ],
    "…": "…"
  }
}
```

**Example — Out of stock** (HTTP 409)

```http
POST /api/v1/shop/orders
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "product_id": "0a000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009",
      "quantity": 1
    }
  ],
  "fulfillment": "PICKUP",
  "payment_method": "ONLINE"
}
```

Advance an order: PLACED -> CONFIRMED -> READY_FOR_PICKUP | OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> COMPLETED.

<a id="shoporderCancel"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/shop/orders/:id/cancel` — shop.orderCancel

Cancel an order: restores stock and refunds.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER (own only), FRONT_DESK, STORE_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: ShopOrderDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-SHOP-010, FR-INV-001 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-SHOP-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `shop_orders`, `products`, `payments` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Rules / behaviour:** MEMBER may cancel only own order while PLACED. Staff while not COMPLETED/CANCELLED. Adds the quantities back to products.stock_quantity and refunds the payment in full (the order then reports payment_status REFUNDED).

<a id="inventoryadjust"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments` — inventory.adjust

Restock or correct the stock of a product.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | STORE_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: InventoryItem` |
| **Requirements** | FR-INV-003 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-SHOP-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-SHOP-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `products` |

**Request body** — type `InventoryAdjustRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `quantity_change` | int | **yes** | non-zero; negative allowed only if the result stays >= 0 (else VALIDATION_ERROR) |

**Rules / behaviour:** `UPDATE products SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :change WHERE id = :id AND stock_quantity + :change >= 0`. products.stock_quantity is the stock: there is no separate ledger (ADR-016).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Product not found. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments
```

```json
  "quantity_change": 1
}
```

```json
    "category": "RACKET",

    "is_active": true
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND",
```

<a id="barmenuStock"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/bar/menu-items/:id/stock-adjustments` — bar.menuStock

Kitchen stock: restock or correct the quantity on hand of one menu item.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | KITCHEN_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: BarMenuItem` |
| **Requirements** | FR-BAR-011 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `bar_menu_items` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Request body** — type `BarMenuStockRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quantity_change` | int | **yes** | non-zero; negative allowed only if the result stays >= 0 (else VALIDATION_ERROR) |

**Rules / behaviour:** `UPDATE bar_menu_items SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + :change WHERE id = :id AND stock_quantity + :change >= 0`. Cafe orders take stock off the same column (R-SHOP-02 style, OUT_OF_STOCK when short) and a cancelled order puts it back. Shop products are not reachable from here: the kitchen manager has no access to /inventory.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |

<a id="barorderCreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/bar/orders` — bar.orderCreate

Take a cafe order for a table label, member or guest. Appears instantly on the kitchen board.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: BarOrderDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-BAR-003, FR-BAR-004, FR-BAR-005, FR-BAR-008, FR-BAR-013, FR-KIT-001 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-BAR-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-BAR-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-BAR-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-BAR-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-BAR-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `bar_orders`, `bar_order_items`, `payments` |

**Request body** — type `BarOrderCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `table_label` | string | no | free text, e.g. "T3" or "Court side" |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | Staff only: book/order on behalf of this member. MEMBER callers: omit (implied = self). |
| `guest_name` | string | no |  |
| `items` | object[] | **yes** | 1-50 lines |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `bar_menu_item_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `quantity` | int | **yes** | 1-50 |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `notes` | string | no |  |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | no | pay now (CASH\|CARD\|UPI); omit to pay later at the desk |
| `notes` | text | no |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** At least one of table_label, member_id, guest_name. Member discount = subtotal x bar_discount_percent of the member's CURRENT plan, stored as discount_amount (automatic; never asked). Guests pay list price. Snapshot unit_price + item_name. The order starts NEW. Totals and payment_status are derived (view bar_order_totals).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `MENU_ITEM_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Menu item not found. |
| `MENU_ITEM_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | Menu item is currently unavailable. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |

**Example — Front desk takes an order for a Gold member at a table (15% auto-discount)**

```http
POST /api/v1/bar/orders
```

```json
    },

      "quantity": 1,
      "notes": "extra salt"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
    "order_number": "BO-000023",
```

<a id="kitchenstatus"></a>
#### `PATCH /api/v1/kitchen/orders/:id/status` — kitchen.status

Move an order along: NEW -> PREPARING -> READY -> SERVED (reject a NEW order with CANCELLED; a READY order may go back to PREPARING).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | KITCHEN_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: KitchenOrder` |
| **Requirements** | FR-KIT-003, FR-KIT-005 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-BAR-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-BAR-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `bar_orders` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Request body** — type `KitchenStatusRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum ORDER_STATUS | **yes** | next status per ORDER_TRANSITIONS |

**Rules / behaviour:** bar_orders.status is the only record of progress: there is no separate status history.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Order not found. |
| `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | 409 | This status change is not allowed. |

**Example — Mark an order READY**

```http
PATCH /api/v1/kitchen/orders/:id/status
```

```json
{
  "status": "READY"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "order_number": "BO-000020",
    "status": "READY",
    "…": "…"
  }
}
```

**Example — Skipping a step** (HTTP 409)

```http
PATCH /api/v1/kitchen/orders/:id/status
```

```json
{
  "status": "SERVED"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION",
    "message": "This status change is not allowed.",
    "details": {
      "from": "NEW",
      "to": "SERVED",
      "allowed": [
        "PREPARING",
        "CANCELLED"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### Module: Enquiries

*Owner: Dev 1 (Platform, Identity & Public Experience)*

<a id="enquiriescreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/enquiries` — enquiries.create

Submit an enquiry or trial-session request. Staff use the same endpoint to log phone and walk-in enquiries.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Optional for PUBLIC callers; staff send Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC, FRONT_DESK, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: EnquiryView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-ENQ-001, FR-ENQ-002, FR-ENQ-003, FR-PUB-006 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-ENQ-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `enquiries` |

**Request body** — type `EnquiriesCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | **yes** |  |
| `phone` | phone | **yes** |  |
| `email` | email | no |  |
| `enquiry_type` | enum ENQUIRY_TYPE | no | default GENERAL |
| `message` | text | no |  |
| `membership_plan_id` | uuid | no |  |
| `sport_type` | enum SPORT_TYPE | no | TRIAL |
| `preferred_start_at` | datetime | no | TRIAL: must be in the future |

**Rules / behaviour:** Stored with handled_at NULL: it waits in the front desk inbox until somebody handles it. Rate-limit public submissions (5/hour/IP).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership plan not found. |

**Example — Visitor requests a tennis trial (no login)**

```http
POST /api/v1/enquiries
```

```json
  "name": "Siddharth Rao",
  "phone": "+919900100002",

}
```

```json
  "message": "Thanks! The club will contact you shortly.",

    "id": "…",

    "handled_at": null,
    "…": "…"
  }
}
```

**Example error (HTTP 404)**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "MEMBERSHIP_PLAN_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Membership plan not found."
```
```json
  }
}
```

<a id="enquiriesapproveTrial"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/enquiries/:id/approve-trial` — enquiries.approveTrial

Approve a trial request: the first free active court of the sport is booked for the visitor as a free TRIAL court booking (shows in the owner and front-desk calendars).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: EnquiryView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-ENQ-004, FR-COURT-004 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `enquiries`, `court_bookings` |
| **Path params** | `id` (uuid) |

**Rules / behaviour:** One transaction: lock the enquiry (must be TRIAL, still waiting) -> re-check the slot and pick a free court (BOOKING_CONFLICT if it was taken meanwhile: the owner declines or the desk rebooks) -> INSERT court_bookings (booking_type TRIAL, list_price 0, guest name / phone / email from the request) -> set handled_at and trial_booking_id.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `ENQUIRY_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Enquiry not found. |
| `TRIAL_REQUEST_CLOSED` | 409 | This trial request is not waiting for a decision. |
| `BOOKING_CONFLICT` | 409 | This court is already booked for that time. |
| `INVALID_SLOT` | 422 | Start time must be on a 30-minute boundary, in the future, within opening hours. |
| `COURT_UNAVAILABLE` | 409 | Court is closed, inactive, blocked, or outside opening hours. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
POST /api/v1/enquiries/07000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/approve-trial
```

```json
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "07000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
    "enquiry_type": "GENERAL",
    "name": "Anita Deshmukh",
    "email": "anita.d@example.com",
    "phone": "+919900100001",
    "message": "What are your timings and do you offer coaching for beginners?",
    "membership_plan_id": null,
    "sport_type": null,
    "preferred_start_at": null,
    "created_at": "2026-10-03T04:10:00.000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-10-03T04:10:00.000Z",
    "handled_at": null,
    "trial_booking_id": null,
    "plan_name": "Aarav Kapoor"
  }
}
```

```json
    "code": "TRIAL_REQUEST_CLOSED",
    "message": "This trial request is not waiting for a decision."
  }

```

### Module: Invoices

*Owner: Dev 4 (Owner, Finance & Reporting)*

<a id="invoiceslist"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/invoices` — invoices.list

List invoices (the owner sees all; a member only their membership invoices).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER (own only), OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: InvoiceView[]` + `meta: PageMeta` |
| **Requirements** | FR-INVC-005, FR-INVC-008, FR-FIN-006, FR-INVC-009 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-INVC-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `invoices`, `invoice_items`, `payments` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum INVOICE_STATUS | no |  |
| `payment_state` | enum INVOICE_PAYMENT_STATE | no |  |
| `invoice_type` | enum INVOICE_TYPE | no |  |
| `business_client_id` | uuid | no | OWNER_ADMIN only |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | OWNER_ADMIN only |
| `from` | date | no |  |
| `to` | date | no |  |
| `overdue` | bool | no |  |
| `page` | int | no | default 1 |
| `page_size` | int | no | default 20, max 100 |

**Rules / behaviour:** Paid / partially paid / overdue are DERIVED by the view invoice_totals (payment_state): OVERDUE = a SENT invoice whose due_date is before today (IST) and that is not fully paid. Nothing is persisted by a job.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |


<a id="invoicescreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/invoices` — invoices.create

Create a business-client or membership invoice.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: InvoiceDetail` |
| **Requirements** | FR-INVC-002, FR-INVC-006, FR-INVC-003 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-FIN-03](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `invoices`, `invoice_items` |

**Request body** — type `InvoicesCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `business_client_id` | uuid | no | addressed to a business client (exactly one of business_client_id / member_id) |
| `member_id` | uuid | no | addressed to a member (membership invoice) |
| `issue_date` | date | no | default today |
| `due_date` | date | **yes** | >= issue_date |
| `items` | object[] | **yes** | >=1 line |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `description` | string | **yes** |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `quantity` | int | **yes** |  |
| &nbsp;&nbsp;↳ `unit_price` | money | **yes** | TAX-EXCLUSIVE |
| `tax_rate` | percent | no | default setting tax_rate_business |
| `notes` | text | no |  |
| `send_now` | bool | no |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** Invoices are tax-EXCLUSIVE: subtotal = sum(quantity x unit_price); tax_amount = round(subtotal x tax_rate / 100, 2); total_amount = subtotal + tax_amount. Only the lines and tax_rate are stored; the totals are derived (view invoice_totals).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `BUSINESS_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Business client not found. |
| `MEMBER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Member not found. |

**Example — Owner invoices a business client (tax-exclusive lines)**

```http
POST /api/v1/invoices
```

```json
{
  "business_client_id": "04000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "due_date": "2026-10-17",
  "items": [
    {
      "description": "Padel court hire (8 sessions)",
      "quantity": 8,
      "unit_price": "1000.00"
    }
  ],
  "send_now": true
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "invoice_number": "INV-00007",
    "invoice_type": "BUSINESS",
```

### Module: Payments

*Owner: Dev 4 (Owner, Finance & Reporting)*

<a id="paymentscreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/payments` — payments.create

Record a payment against a court booking, membership, shop order, cafe order or invoice.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | MEMBER (own only), FRONT_DESK, KITCHEN_MANAGER, STORE_MANAGER, OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: PaymentView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-FIN-001, FR-FIN-002, FR-INVC-004, FR-FIN-010 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-FIN-01](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-04](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-05](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-11](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-INVC-02](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `payments`, `court_bookings`, `shop_orders`, `bar_orders`, `invoices` |

**Request body** — type `PaymentsCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_type` | enum PAYMENT_SOURCE_TYPE | **yes** |  |
| `source_id` | uuid | **yes** |  |
| `amount` | money | no | default = remaining due. Partial payments allowed ONLY for INVOICE; every other source must equal the full amount due |
| `payment_method` | enum PAYMENT_METHOD | **yes** | MEMBER: ONLINE only. FRONT_DESK: CASH \| CARD \| UPI. OWNER_ADMIN: any |
| `gateway_reference` | string | no |  |
| `notes` | text | no |  |

**Rules / behaviour:** The revenue category is derived from source_type (INVOICE: BUSINESS or MEMBERSHIP by the invoice recipient) by the view payment_ledger. tax_amount is computed at payment time (tax-inclusive sources) or pro rata (invoices). No status is written on the thing being paid: its payment status is derived from its payments. ONLINE goes through the mock gateway of the hackathon build (ADR-011): an amount whose paise are .13 (e.g. 100.13) returns PAYMENT_FAILED.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `PAYMENT_FAILED` | 402 | Payment could not be completed. |
| `PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH` | 422 | Payment amount does not match the amount due. |
| `ALREADY_PAID` | 409 | This item is already fully paid. |
| `BOOKING_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Booking not found. |
| `ORDER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Order not found. |
| `INVOICE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Invoice not found. |
| `MEMBERSHIP_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Membership not found. |

**Example — Business client pays part of an invoice online**

```http
POST /api/v1/payments
```

```json
{
  "source_type": "INVOICE",
  "source_id": "11000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
  "amount": "5000.00",
  "payment_method": "ONLINE"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "payment_number": "PAY-0000058",
    "source_type": "INVOICE",
    "source_id": "11000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
    "revenue_category": "BUSINESS",
    "amount": "5000.00",
    "tax_amount": "762.71",
    "method": "ONLINE",
    "status": "SUCCEEDED",
    "…": "…"
  }
}
```

**Example — Partial amount on a booking** (HTTP 422)

```http
POST /api/v1/payments
```

```json
{
  "source_type": "COURT_BOOKING",
  "source_id": "…",
  "amount": "100.00",
  "payment_method": "CASH"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH",
    "message": "Payment amount does not match the amount due.",
    "details": {
      "amount_due": "800.00"
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="staffapplicationCreate"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/staff/applications` — staff.applicationCreate

A visitor applies to work at the club. Nothing is granted until the owner approves; the applicant can log in to see the status.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | None (PUBLIC) |
| **Roles** | PUBLIC |
| **Success** | 201 · `data: EmployeeApplicationPending` |
| **Requirements** | FR-AUTH-008, FR-STAFF-008 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `employee_applications` |

**Request body** — type `StaffApplicationCreateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | string | **yes** | 2-120 chars |
| `email` | email | **yes** |  |
| `phone` | phone | **yes** |  |
| `password` | string | **yes** | min 8 chars, >=1 letter and >=1 digit; kept only as a bcrypt hash until the owner decides |

**Rules / behaviour:** Creates a PENDING `employee_applications` row. No `users` / `staff` row exists yet. One PENDING application per email.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `EMAIL_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this email already exists. |
| `APPLICATION_PENDING` | 409 | A job application for this email is already waiting for the owner. Log in to see its status. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
POST /api/v1/staff/applications
```

```json
  "phone": "+919811100001",
  "password": "Password@123"
}
```

```json
  "data": {

    "redirect_to": "unknown"
  }
}
```

**Example error (HTTP 409)**

```json

  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "EMAIL_TAKEN",
    "message": "An account with this email already exists."
```
```json
  }
}
```

<a id="staffapplicationApprove"></a>
#### `POST /api/v1/staff/applications/:id/approve` — staff.applicationApprove

Approve an application and choose the role: creates the login (same email and password) and the staff record.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: EmployeeApplicationView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-STAFF-008 |
| **Governing rules** | — |

**Request body** — type `StaffApplicationApproveRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | enum USER_ROLE | **yes** | FRONT_DESK \| KITCHEN_MANAGER \| STORE_MANAGER |
| `designation` | string | no | default: the role name |
| `monthly_salary` | money | no | default 0.00 |

**Rules / behaviour:** One transaction: lock the PENDING application, create `users` (bcrypt hash copied, role, active) + `staff`, mark it APPROVED with approved_role / reviewer / reviewed_at, clear the stored hash.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Job application not found. |
| `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | 409 | This status change is not allowed. |
| `EMAIL_TAKEN` | 409 | An account with this email already exists. |

### Module: Reports

<a id="reportsdashboard"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard` — reports.dashboard

Owner dashboard KPIs for today / this week / this month across every module.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: OwnerDashboard` |
| **Requirements** | FR-REP-001, FR-FIN-009, FR-MEM-014 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-FIN-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-08](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md), [R-FIN-10](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `payments`, `memberships`, `court_bookings`, `shop_orders`, `bar_orders`, `enquiries`, `invoices`, `payroll_payments`, `leave_requests`, `products` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | enum REPORT_PERIOD | **yes** | TODAY = IST today; WEEK = Monday..today; MONTH = 1st..today |

**Rules / behaviour:** Revenue = SUM(payments.amount - refunded_amount) by paid_at in the range (IST), grouped by the derived revenue_category (view payment_ledger).

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |

<a id="reportstaxOverview"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/reports/tax-overview` — reports.taxOverview

Internal "Taxes to report" overview of one calendar month: taxable revenue, tax collected, input tax credit, estimated payable and the internal reporting status. Not a government filing.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: TaxOverview` |
| **Requirements** | FR-REP-007, FR-FIN-007 |
| **Governing rules** | [R-FIN-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `payments`, `tax_inputs`, `tax_periods` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period` | string | **yes** | YYYY-MM (IST calendar month) |

**Rules / behaviour:** Taxable revenue and tax collected are the reports.tax figures for the month (payments net of refunds, tax pro-rated); input tax credit = eligible tax_inputs dated in the month; estimated payable = max(0, collected - credit) and the leftover credit is shown as credit_balance. Status: REPORTED once the owner marked the month, else READY_TO_REPORT after the month ended, else NOT_READY.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |

| **Governing rules** | [R-FIN-07](../business-rules/BUSINESS_RULES.md) |
| **Tables touched** | `tax_periods` |
| **Path params** | `period` (uuid) |

**Rules / behaviour:** Only a month that has ended can be marked; marking twice is harmless.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resource not found. |

<a id="reportsexport"></a>
#### `GET /api/v1/reports/export` — reports.export

Download a report as CSV to share with an accountant / partners. Response is text/csv, NOT the JSON envelope.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `text/csv` file (Content-Disposition: attachment) — NOT the JSON envelope |
| **Requirements** | FR-REP-008 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `payments`, `court_bookings`, `members`, `shop_orders`, `bar_orders` |

**Query parameters**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `report` | enum EXPORT_REPORT | **yes** |  |
| `from` | date | **yes** | Inclusive IST business date. |
| `to` | date | **yes** | Inclusive IST business date; to >= from; max 366 days. |

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
GET /api/v1/reports/export?report=REVENUE&from=2026-10-10&to=2026-10-10
```

```csv
date,category,method,amount,tax_amount
2026-10-03,COURT,UPI,800.00,122.03
```

**Example error (HTTP 400)**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Request validation failed."
  }
}
```

<a id="settingsupdate"></a>
#### `PATCH /api/v1/settings/:key` — settings.update

Change one setting (hours, tax rates, delivery fee, cut-offs...).

| | |
|---|---|
| **Auth** | Bearer JWT |
| **Roles** | OWNER_ADMIN |
| **Success** | 200 · `data: SettingView` |
| **Requirements** | FR-SET-001 |
| **Governing rules** | — |
| **Tables touched** | `club_settings` |
| **Path params** | `key` (uuid→ setting key) |

**Request body** — type `SettingsUpdateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | string | **yes** | JSON scalar matching the existing value's type (string \| number \| boolean) |

**Rules / behaviour:** Only existing keys listed in SETTING_KEYS can be changed. `value` is validated against the type of the current value.

**Errors**

| Code | HTTP | Meaning here |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Authentication required or token expired. |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | You do not have permission to perform this action. |
| `SETTING_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Setting not found. |

**Example (generated from the types and seed data — shape is exact, values illustrative)**

```http
PATCH /api/v1/settings/club_name
```

```json
{
  "value": "string"
}
```

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "key": "club_name",
    "value": "value",
    "description": "Sample text",
    "is_public": true,
    "updated_at": "2026-10-03T12:30:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

**Example error (HTTP 404)**

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "SETTING_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Setting not found."
  }
}
```
